scoring_method: Each dimension is scored from 0 to 100 and multiplied by its weight. Only reproducible local evidence, code/test evidence, or explicitly documented evidence receives credit. The score is not a production SLA, capacity result, or security certification.

dimensions.name: requirements_and_core_functionality
dimensions.evidence: Stages 0-19 cover authentication, organization, projects/tasks, comments, attachments, reminders, notifications, audit, frontend and deployment paths; full browser E2E and malware scanning remain incomplete.

dimensions.name: architecture_and_explainability
dimensions.evidence: The modular monolith has explicit MySQL, Redis, RabbitMQ and MinIO boundaries, state-machine validation, optimistic concurrency, idempotency and compensation paths; the topology is still local-learning oriented.

dimensions.name: security_and_data_protection
dimensions.evidence: Backend authorization, session revocation, login-window rate limiting, data scope, attachment signature checks, production weak-secret rejection, security headers and profile-based management-plane settings are verified by tests or static configuration checks; localStorage tokens, plaintext local transport, external Secret Manager/rotation, and production proxy isolation remain material gaps.

dimensions.name: tests_builds_and_regression
dimensions.evidence: Maven 64 tests with 0 failures and 1 optional skip, explicit Testcontainers verification, frontend build, Compose config and Kind verification are recorded; the optional test is skipped by default and browser E2E is incomplete.

dimensions.name: evaluation_and_observability
dimensions.evidence: A fixed local performance baseline, runtime metrics, EXPLAIN output, Actuator metrics and report artifacts exist; results are single-machine evidence and online dependency scanning/target-environment replay are pending.

dimensions.name: runtime_integration_and_recovery_readiness
dimensions.evidence: Six-service Compose health, persistent restart, Kind application probes, pod recovery and rolling restart passed; middleware remains single-instance and there is no production Ingress/TLS/HPA/multi-node HA evidence.

dimensions.name: engineering_governance
dimensions.evidence: Stage documents, scripts, F-drive path policy and changelog are maintained; complete CI, coverage gates, online dependency scanning and unified quality gates are not established.

dimensions.name: documentation_and_delivery_credibility
dimensions.evidence: README, CHANGELOG, stage documents, Chinese interview material and the acceptance report distinguish local evidence from production claims.
